participants: 实际存在的海商与港口

title.en: Put the Land Tax in One Register

desc.zh: 在实际拥有的试点州核查田粮、官署就业与投入品短缺。可走中央清查、地方联核或有限旧额；中央路线要求现行土地/人头/比例税法基础，两次核账至少间隔三个月。条件不足时可补就业或改善供给后等待。
desc.en: Audit land tax, office staffing and input shortages in a state you actually own. Central review requires an existing land-based, per-capita or proportional taxation law; the two audits must be at least three months apart. If capacity is short, improve staffing or supply and wait.

journals.goal: { has_variable = ywc_shu_register_pilot_resolved OR = { AND = { has_variable = ywc_shu_first_audit has_variable = ywc_shu_second_audit } var:ywc_shu_pilot_outcome = 3 } }

title.en: The New Register Must Honor Old Duties

desc.zh: 将前期账务决定用于军饷、地方供役或海商预垫。六个月后复核预算、官署投入品与试点州；战争、失地、违约和财政恶化允许限缩或撤回，且不退已付款。
desc.en: Apply the first stage’s fiscal choice to military pay, provincial service or merchant credit. After six months, review the budget, office inputs and pilot state; war, lost territory, default or fiscal decline permit a limited settlement or withdrawal without refunding past payments.

desc.zh: 县吏把田粮册送入户部，军镇的供役名簿却列着另一批人。地方缙绅不肯先交旧免额，直到朝廷说清谁能核、谁负担纸笔。
desc.en: The county clerks send one grain ledger to the Board of Revenue; the garrison service roll lists a different set of households. Local gentry withhold their old exemptions until the court says who may audit and who pays for the paper.

label.zh: 派员清查：中央持册
label.en: Send auditors: central register

cost_note.zh: 开启时年总收入÷52，最低100；首笔实扣一周估算的一半，余款在第二次核账时扣。
cost_note.en: At opening, estimate one week as yearly gross income ÷ 52, minimum 100; deduct half now and the remainder at the second audit.

consequence_note.zh: 中央取得查核权；须有本体税法基础、指定官署投入品不短缺与正向预算能力。
consequence_note.en: The court gains audit authority, subject to an existing tax law, an adequately supplied pilot office and an affordable budget.

label.zh: 地方联核：以留用换呈报权
label.en: Joint audit: local reporting rights

cost_note.zh: 先不收审计费；若后来选择补偿征收，按两倍成本基数一次实扣。
cost_note.en: No audit fee now; compensated collection later deducts twice the cost base.

consequence_note.zh: 地方获得查册权，朝廷接受较低中央覆盖与一年分担义务。
consequence_note.en: Provinces gain inspection rights; the court accepts lower central coverage and a one-year sharing obligation.

label.zh: 封顶旧额：保住供役旧约
label.en: Cap old quotas: preserve service custom

cost_note.zh: 无启动款；目标缩为本地旧额核对，不宣称全国清丈。
cost_note.en: No start-up payment; scope narrows to local quota review, not a national survey.

consequence_note.zh: 保留缙绅与军镇旧约，也承认中央覆盖不足。
consequence_note.en: Preserves gentry and garrison custom while acknowledging limited central coverage.

purpose.zh: 确立中央持册、地方共核或保守封顶三种互斥开局，并留下真实账务义务。
purpose.en: Choose among central audit, provincial co-audit or a conservative cap, each with a real fiscal obligation.

reads: 是否提前建立行政能力

title.en: Where the Survey Clerks Will Work

desc.zh: 清查官须在指定试点州使用官署；该建筑就业达到八成且没有建筑投入品短缺，才可按真实行政结余记账。已满足条件者直接承认，不要求为了剧情回退法律。
desc.en: Auditors must use an office in the designated pilot state. Its government administration building must reach 80% occupancy and have no building input shortage; then a real positive administrative balance can support the audit. Existing capacity is recognized.

label.zh: 以现有官署、税法与投入品条件记第一次账
label.en: Record the first audit with existing offices and tax law

cost_note.zh: 首笔仅在预算可支付时实扣 开启时一周收入估算基数的一半；不满足官署/投入品条件时不扣、不记账。
cost_note.en: Deduct half the captured one-week income estimate only when the budget permits; missing office/input conditions incur no charge and record no audit.

consequence_note.zh: 还需土地税、人头税或比例税法基础，以及试点官署就业≥80%、无建筑投入品短缺和 bureaucracy≥0。
consequence_note.en: Also requires land-based, per-capita or proportional taxation, ≥80% pilot-office occupancy, no building input shortage and bureaucracy ≥0.

label.zh: 地方书吏联署，承认地方查册权
label.en: Use local clerks and recognize provincial review

cost_note.zh: 不直接生成官员；选择时不扣款，后续补偿另计。
cost_note.en: No clerks are created; this choice has no charge, later compensation is billed separately.

consequence_note.zh: 地方取得复核权，中央覆盖率较低；若无可用州，选择只会留下等待标记。
consequence_note.en: Local gentry receive review rights and central coverage is lower; a real owned state is required.

label.zh: 暂缓发册，先补行政与官署投入品
label.en: Wait for offices and their building inputs

cost_note.zh: 暂不扣费，也不计为核账。
cost_note.en: No charge; this does not count as an audit.

consequence_note.zh: 先建设并补就业，或改善试点官署投入品供给；十二个月仍受阻会提示，三十六个月可缩限。
consequence_note.en: Build and staff an office or improve its inputs; a 12-month blockage prompts review, and 36 months permits narrowing the pilot.

purpose.zh: 读取试点州的官署就业、建筑投入品短缺与行政结余，不凭空生成就业或声称检查纸张市场。
purpose.en: Read staffing and input shortages at the pilot-state office plus the real bureaucracy balance; do not create jobs or claim to inspect the paper market.

title.en: An Exemption Has Its Own History

desc.zh: 地主递上祖传免额，附有修桥、供役的旧账。军镇说若重估税额就先补军饷；县吏提醒，重征不能把同一户的徭役抹成不存在。
desc.en: Landowners present inherited exemptions with old bridge and service accounts. The garrison asks for pay before any reassessment; county clerks warn that a new tax roll does not erase duplicate labor demands.

ywc_v03_can_deliver_major = yes

	ywc_shu_v03_unsettled = yes
			has_variable = ywc_shu_first_audit
}

label.zh: 成文有限免额，地方承担供役
label.en: Write a time-limited exemption with local service

cost_note.zh: 无即时扣款；标记地方复核权与 12 个月分担。
cost_note.en: No immediate deduction; records local review rights and 12 months of shared duties.

consequence_note.zh: 中央放弃部分覆盖换取地方供役和可复核期限。
consequence_note.en: The court gives up some coverage for local service and a reviewable term.

label.zh: 照册征收，补偿地主损失
label.en: Collect by the roll and compensate landowners

cost_note.zh: 实扣 一周收入估算基数的两倍；若行政财政不允许，不付款、不记补偿。
cost_note.en: Deduct twice the one-week income estimate; if the budget gate fails, neither payment nor compensation is recorded.

consequence_note.zh: 地主失去旧免额，获得一次补偿；反对标记留给后续核账。
consequence_note.en: Landowners lose the exemption but receive one compensation; their objection remains in the later audit.

label.zh: 维持旧例，只核对边界
label.en: Keep custom and audit only its boundary

cost_note.zh: 无即时扣款；放弃全国税基覆盖的表述。
cost_note.en: No immediate charge; the card gives up any claim of national tax-base coverage.

consequence_note.zh: 承认受挫妥协，以有限旧额继续，仍可进入后期重议。
consequence_note.en: Accepts a bounded compromise and keeps later renegotiation open.

purpose.zh: 建立可撤销、有限期的免额和补偿承诺，并把旧利益传给后续节点。
purpose.en: Record bounded, reversible exemptions and compensation, carrying the distributional choice forward.

title.en: The Garrison Claims Its Share First

desc.zh: 武勋军镇把守边账与欠饷单并排放在案头。无战事也有轮值和驻防开销；地方官主张自己的税款不能被中央一笔带走。
desc.en: The military households place their border duty accounts beside their unpaid-pay petitions. Rotations and garrisons cost money even in peace; provincial officials argue that their tax share cannot simply disappear into the central chest.

events.trigger:
{
c:SHU ?= this
ywc_v03_can_deliver_major = yes
	has_journal_entry = ywc_je_v03_shu_register_pilot
	ywc_shu_v03_unsettled = yes
			has_variable = ywc_shu_first_audit
}

label.zh: 先付一笔核对过的军饷预付款
label.en: Pay a verified partial pay advance

cost_note.zh: 最多扣成本基数的四分之一；财政门槛不满足时不付款。
cost_note.en: Deduct at most one quarter of the cost base; no payment if the fiscal gate fails.

consequence_note.zh: 记录军方由中央预付，但不宣称欠饷已全部结清。
consequence_note.en: Records central advance responsibility without claiming all arrears are cleared.

label.zh: 列入预算次序，不承诺额外军心
label.en: Put it in the budget queue without promising goodwill

cost_note.zh: 不立即扣款；未来预算压力由真实国库承担。
cost_note.en: No immediate deduction; future pressure remains on the actual treasury.

consequence_note.zh: 军镇仍须等预算，不能凭选择获得免费支持。
consequence_note.en: The garrison still waits for appropriation; the choice grants no free support.

label.zh: 由地方抵饷，承认对应税权
label.en: Let provinces offset pay and recognize their tax claim

cost_note.zh: 无即时扣款；用地方留用份额换取军镇账务。
cost_note.en: No immediate deduction; provincial retention is exchanged for garrison accounting.

consequence_note.zh: 省朝分工线和本线结局都将读取谁承担供军责任。
consequence_note.en: The provincial division line and this arc’s conclusion both read who bears military supply.

purpose.zh: 让农业税册面对具体的军饷责任，并被后续节点读取。
purpose.en: Make the agrarian tax register answer to concrete military pay obligations and carry that payer forward.

desc.zh: 一户民户的田粮记在县册，修堤和运粮又被军镇算作另一项差役。户部不能凭一桩呈状改写全国人口，但可以决定谁受理这本旧册的申诉。
desc.en: A household appears in the county tax ledger, then again in the garrison’s levee and grain-hauling service rolls. One petition cannot rewrite national population, but the Board can decide who hears the appeal.

{
c:SHU ?= this
ywc_v03_can_deliver_major = yes
	has_journal_entry = ywc_je_v03_shu_register_pilot
	ywc_shu_v03_unsettled = yes
			has_variable = ywc_shu_first_audit
}

label.zh: 交官署复核，承担持续行政工作
label.en: Refer it to the office for a staffed review

cost_note.zh: 无即时扣款；由真实行政结余与岗位供给承担持续工作。
cost_note.en: No immediate deduction; ongoing work must be supported by real bureaucracy and jobs.

consequence_note.zh: 中央形成复核程序，但若官署空缺，个案不会被写成已解决。
consequence_note.en: The court creates a review process; an understaffed office cannot be described as resolving the case.

label.zh: 交地方联核，保留地方裁判
label.en: Refer the petition to provincial mediation

cost_note.zh: 不即时扣款；换取地方裁判与查册权。
cost_note.en: No immediate deduction; trades for local adjudication and inspection rights.

consequence_note.zh: 保护地方旧例，降低中央覆盖，并在结局保留申诉权限。
consequence_note.en: Protects provincial custom and lowers central coverage while preserving local appeals.

label.zh: 不改旧册，缩小本轮覆盖
label.en: Leave the old roll and narrow this pilot

cost_note.zh: 无即时扣款。
cost_note.en: No immediate deduction.

consequence_note.zh: 缙绅暂获稳定，重复供役问题继续留在案卷。
consequence_note.en: Gentry gain short-term stability; duplicate service remains unresolved.

purpose.zh: 具体化重复征役个案，并保证中央复核、地方调停与保守收束有不同责任人。
purpose.en: Turn duplicate service into a concrete case with distinct central, provincial and conservative responsibility.

desc.zh: 海商可以先垫核账银，但要求下一年偿还、参与核对港税。若没有实际港口和商贸基础，这一席改由地方预缴，不虚构商人或海关。
desc.en: Merchants can advance audit funds, asking for repayment next year and a say in checking port dues. Where no real port or trade base exists, the offer becomes provincial prepayment; no merchant or customs house is invented.

events.trigger:
{
c:SHU ?= this
ywc_v03_can_deliver_major = yes
	has_journal_entry = ywc_je_v03_shu_register_pilot
	ywc_shu_v03_unsettled = yes
			has_variable = ywc_shu_first_audit
}

label.zh: 有港口时接纳商人预垫
label.en: Accept the merchant advance where a port exists

cost_note.zh: 不增加国库资金；形成 12 个月偿付义务和港税咨询权。
cost_note.en: Adds no treasury money; records a 12-month repayment duty and port-dues consultation.

consequence_note.zh: 只有真实港口可记录海商预垫；否则是地方预缴提议。
consequence_note.en: Only a real port records a merchant advance; otherwise this becomes a provincial prepayment proposal.

label.zh: 拒绝预垫，不抵押后续港税
label.en: Refuse and avoid pledging future port dues

cost_note.zh: 无即时转账和新债务。
cost_note.en: No transfer and no new repayment debt.

consequence_note.zh: 中央保留未来税则空间，但失去短期商人周转银。
consequence_note.en: The court keeps future tariff freedom but loses short-term merchant liquidity.

label.zh: 缩小清查，不借外银
label.en: Narrow the audit and avoid private credit

cost_note.zh: 不追加审计扣款。
cost_note.en: No additional audit deduction.

consequence_note.zh: 海商线不假设大顺工业化，有限旧额仍可正常结算。
consequence_note.en: Does not assume maritime trade means industrialization; a limited old-quota settlement remains valid.

purpose.zh: 海商参与取决于真实港口，并把预垫与下一年度偿还、港税咨询连接起来。
purpose.en: Merchant participation depends on real ports and links any advance to next year’s repayment and customs consultation.

title.zh: 第二次核账，或承认久阻
title.en: The Second Audit, or a Long-Stalled Pilot

desc.zh: 两次正式核账至少相隔三个月。若三十六个月仍卡在官署、投入品或财政条件，可以承认试点受挫、转为有限旧额，不把未发生的第二次核账写成完成。
desc.en: The two formal audits must be at least three months apart. If staffing, input supply or fiscal conditions still block progress after 36 months, acknowledge a limited pilot rather than recording an audit that never happened.

label.zh: 公布中央核出的差额
label.en: Publish the centrally audited difference

cost_note.zh: 第二笔审计估算额为 一周收入估算基数的一半；财政不允许时保留待办，不记已付。
cost_note.en: Second half-installment equals half the one-week income estimate; if the budget gate fails it remains due, not paid.

consequence_note.zh: 必须满足本地官署、行政结余、纸张与两次核账；点击本身不创造税收。
consequence_note.en: Requires a local office, non-negative bureaucracy, paper availability and both audits; the button creates no tax revenue.

label.zh: 承认地方分担，按较低覆盖结算
label.en: Settle as provincial sharing at lower coverage

cost_note.zh: 按审计基数比例支付；地方分担不生成额外银两。
cost_note.en: Pays the audit share calculated from the proxy; provincial sharing creates no money.

consequence_note.zh: 前提是已有地方联核/分税责任，结局须承认较低中央覆盖。
consequence_note.en: Requires an actual provincial co-audit or tax-sharing commitment and accepts lower central coverage.

label.zh: 暂停清查，保留有限旧额
label.en: Pause and retain bounded old quotas

cost_note.zh: 不退前款，不产生第二笔扣款。
cost_note.en: Earlier payments are not refunded; no second installment is taken.

consequence_note.zh: 只要坚持有限旧额即可进入后段；这是承认试点受挫，不伪称第二次核账。
consequence_note.en: Proceed to settlement as a bounded, limited pilot; this acknowledges the failed expansion and does not claim a second audit.

purpose.zh: 以真实条件完成第二次审查，且有中央、地方、旧额三种可结算分类。
purpose.en: Finish a second real-world check with central, provincial and legacy settlement categories.

desc.zh: 户部要把新册上的收入用在军饷、地方供役还是海关垫款上。中央查核、地方分担、旧额封顶互相排斥，不能同时取三份好处。
desc.en: The Board must assign the new register’s claims to military pay, local service or merchant advances. Central audit, provincial sharing and capped quotas are mutually exclusive; the court cannot claim all three gains.

label.zh: 中央负责军饷与公共项目
label.en: Central court pays garrisons and public duties

cost_note.zh: 六个月观察期内须保持净固定收入非负；不追加免征法令。
cost_note.en: Maintain non-negative net fixed income for the six-month review; no tax law is granted.

consequence_note.zh: 中央查核路线继续；真实军饷与官署支出仍由预算承担。
consequence_note.en: Continues the central audit path; real pay and office costs remain on the budget.

label.zh: 地方留用一份，换共同供役
label.en: Retain a provincial share for shared service

cost_note.zh: 六个月观察地方履约；中央覆盖率较低。
cost_note.en: Observe local performance for six months at lower central coverage.

consequence_note.zh: 地方查册权与军镇分担进入结局；海商预垫不能抵销它。
consequence_note.en: Provincial review and garrison sharing carry forward; merchant advances cannot cancel them.

label.zh: 封顶旧额，承认中央只管试点
label.en: Cap old dues and keep only the pilot in central reach

cost_note.zh: 不退已付费用，也不延伸全国征收。
cost_note.en: Earlier payments are not refunded and collection is not extended nationally.

consequence_note.zh: 允许保守秩序继续，但不领取中央查核成果。
consequence_note.en: Allows conservative continuity without claiming the central-audit result.

purpose.zh: 把核查结果绑定军饷、地方供役与商人垫款，六个月后再验证可支付性。
purpose.en: Bind audit results to military pay, provincial service and merchant credit, then review affordability after six months.

title.en: The Register Meets War and Austerity

desc.zh: 六个月巩固期到来。平时审查净固定收入与官署投入品；真实战争、破产、预算转负或试点失地时不装作和平，改作战时限缩或信用修复。
desc.en: The six-month consolidation review arrives. In peace it checks net fixed income, offices and building inputs. Real war, default, a negative budget or loss of the pilot state moves the court to a wartime limit or credit repair instead of pretending conditions are normal.

label.zh: 和平审查：保留能支付的安排
label.en: Peace review: retain what is affordable

cost_note.zh: 不另扣款；按真实预算检查。
cost_note.en: No extra deduction; uses the actual budget.

consequence_note.zh: 条件达标才可确立，否则后续选项只能妥协或封顶。
consequence_note.en: Establishment requires real conditions; otherwise only compromise or cap can close.

label.zh: 战时/财政受挫：保留试点，暂停并重启六个月审查
label.en: Defer in war or fiscal distress; restart the six-month review later

cost_note.zh: 保留已付款项，不追加预算；延后责任仍记录。
cost_note.en: Keep prior payments, add no new charge, and retain deferred obligations.

consequence_note.zh: 不强迫停战；中断会清零，和平恢复且试点仍在后，重新开启完整六个月审查。
consequence_note.en: No forced peace. The interrupted review resets; once peace and the pilot state return, a fresh six-month review begins.

label.zh: 撤回承诺，进入信用修复
label.en: Withdraw and repair fiscal credibility

cost_note.zh: 不退已付款，也不再新增承诺。
cost_note.en: Keep past payments and take on no new obligations.

consequence_note.zh: 主动退出被记为失信；后续海关与省朝线仍可重谈。
consequence_note.en: Active withdrawal is recorded as breach; later customs and provincial lines can renegotiate.

purpose.zh: 检查长期和平、战争与财政逆转；保留已付款并允许明确退出。
purpose.en: Check prolonged peace, war and fiscal reversal; preserve payments already made and allow an explicit withdrawal.

desc.zh: 结算不是一条免费加税法令。朝廷逐项确认谁核账、谁供役、海商是否垫银，和净固定收入能否支撑官署；未达到的只能按局部妥协、旧额或失信退出。
desc.en: Settlement is not a free tax law. The court records who audited, who supplied service, whether merchants advanced funds, and whether net fixed income can sustain the office. Unmet conditions permit only a limited compromise, capped custom or breach withdrawal.

{
c:SHU ?= this
ywc_v03_can_deliver_major = yes
	has_journal_entry = ywc_je_v03_shu_fiscal_settlement
	ywc_shu_v03_unsettled = yes
			has_variable = ywc_shu_review_class

label.zh: 确立中央核账
label.en: Establish central audit

cost_note.zh: 无新收入奖励或免法；履行持续行政与军饷预算。
cost_note.en: No revenue reward or tax exemption; administration and pay remain budgeted.

consequence_note.zh: 两次核账、行政供给与可支付性全满足时结果为确立。
consequence_note.en: Established only if both audits, administrative supply and affordability are met.

label.zh: 确立地方分担
label.en: Confirm provincial sharing

cost_note.zh: 无国库转账；保留地方供役及查册义务。
cost_note.en: No treasury transfer; retain provincial service and audit obligations.

consequence_note.zh: 已实际给地方查册权并完成复核时结果为妥协。
consequence_note.en: Compromise requires actual provincial review rights and a completed audit.

label.zh: 有限旧额结算
label.en: Settle with bounded old quotas

cost_note.zh: 不退前款，不声称全国税册完成。
cost_note.en: No refund; does not claim a national register.

consequence_note.zh: 保守守成列为有限结果，未来可从海关或分省改革续接。
consequence_note.en: Conservative continuity is a bounded result, open to later customs or provincial reform.

label.zh: 撤回并承担失信后果
label.en: Withdraw and accept breach consequences

cost_note.zh: 停止未发生的新费用，已付款保留。
cost_note.en: Stop future charges; prior payments remain spent.

consequence_note.zh: 记录撤回失信，不抹除旧债与地方不满。
consequence_note.en: Records breach without erasing old debt or provincial grievances.

purpose.zh: 按真实财政、行政供给和政策承诺完成四种结局，并输出后续线可读的结果分类。
purpose.en: Set one of four outcomes from real budget, administration and policy obligations for later lines to read.

outcomes: central_audit:两次核账、合格税法基础、真实行政/建筑投入品条件与可支付预算持续成立
provincial_share:承认地方查册权并实际分担供役
capped_legacy:缩小覆盖，按可负担旧额继续
withdrawn_breach:保留已付成本并停止新义务
